description: This PHP source file defines the class 'SugarAuthenticateUser', which manages user authentication, session management, and multi-factor authentication logic within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: SugarAuthenticateUser
classes.description: Handles user authentication, including login, user session initialization, and multi-factor authentication processes.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on username and password, returning user ID if successful.

methods.name: isSugarLogin
methods.description: Checks if the user logs in via the SugarCRM authentication method.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Performs user authentication and loads the user into session upon login.

methods.name: loadUserOnSession
methods.description: Loads the user into session based on user ID and verifies if the user is active.

methods.name: isUserNeedFactorAuthentication
methods.description: Checks if the current user requires two-factor authentication.

methods.name: isUserFactorAuthenticated
methods.description: Determines if the user has completed two-factor authentication.

methods.name: isUserFactorTokenReceived
methods.description: Checks if the factor token was received in the request.

methods.name: factorAuthenticateCheck
methods.description: Validates the user's factor authentication status based on session or request token.

methods.name: showFactorTokenInput
methods.description: Displays the input for the user to enter their factor authentication token.

methods.name: isFactorTokenSent
methods.description: Checks if a factor token has been sent to the user.

methods.name: sendFactorTokenToUser
methods.description: Generates and sends a two-factor authentication token via email.

methods.name: redirectToLogout
methods.description: Destroys the session and redirects the user to the logout page.

methods.name: isUserLogoutRequest
methods.description: Determines if the current request is a logout request.

methods.name: isUserRequestedResendToken
methods.description: Checks if the user has requested to resend the factor authentication token.
